ideas.title: Investigating the Trump administration's funding freeze on child care subsidies
ideas.description: This story would investigate the motivations behind the Trump administration's funding freeze on child care subsidies and the impact on families and businesses.
questions: What are the motivations behind the Trump administration's funding freeze?
How will the funding freeze impact families and businesses?
ideas.insight: I believe this story is important because it could reveal potential corruption or mismanagement within the Trump administration. By following the money and examining public records, we may be able to uncover the truth behind the funding freeze.
